subject: french
title: Law and Order
welcome_lead: Society depends on rules. Law, justice and order open rich vocabulary for debate.
meta_desc: French: law, order, justice, and civic responsibility.
final_note: To debate justice in French is to enter civic life.

walkthroughs.body_html: Le juge, l'avocat, le proces. The Code Napoleon (1804) underlies French civil law.
Reference la Declaration des droits de l'homme et du citoyen (1789). Use il est primordial de for emphasis.
For 'la prison reduit-elle la criminalite?', argue with en theorie. en pratique.

mcqs.q: What year was the Code Napoleon?
What is the most common informal way to form a yes/no question in French?
options: Rising intonation (statement said as a question) or using 'est-ce que'.

mcqs.q: Which letter is typically SILENT at the end of French words like 'petit' or 'froid'?
How do you describe weather in the past, e.g. 'it was sunny'?
options: Passé composé - 'Il a fait beau' (which suggests a completed event).
